page.notes: Doubtful readings: "consue etudine" appears to be a printing error for "consuetudine" (a space within the word); left as printed. "pem)" at the line start is a fragment carried from the previous page and is kept as a fragment. "cuius" and "specimē", "hīc" and "cùm" are transcribed from the scan with macrons/accents as printed. The first line's opening letters are cut off at the edge of the scan; the fragment is kept as it stands.
